queue_url.description: Full SQS queue URL used as the fixed queue target. Must be absolute, contain no userinfo/query/fragment, and use https except localhost fixture endpoints. Account-level operations derive the regional SQS endpoint from this URL.

region.description: AWS region used for SigV4 request signing, for example us-east-1.

access_key.description: AWS access key id used for SigV4 request signing. Never logged.

secret_key.description: AWS secret access key used for SigV4 request signing. Never logged.

session_token.description: Optional AWS session token for temporary credentials, sent as X-Amz-Security-Token when set.

endpoint_url.description: Optional AWS-compatible SQS regional endpoint override. Must be an absolute root endpoint with no userinfo/query/fragment and https except localhost fixture endpoints. Leave unset for AWS; the connector derives the service endpoint from queue_url.

max_batch_size.description: Messages requested per ReceiveMessage call (MaxNumberOfMessages), clamped to 1-10.

visibility_timeout.description: Optional ReceiveMessage VisibilityTimeout in seconds, clamped to 0-43200. Uses the queue default when unset.

attributes_to_return.description: Comma-separated MessageAttributeName values requested by ReceiveMessage. Defaults to All.

system_attributes_to_return.description: Comma-separated AttributeName/SystemAttributeName values requested by ReceiveMessage. Defaults to All.

max_polls.description: Maximum ReceiveMessage calls per Read, clamped to 1-100. A poll returning zero messages stops early.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free local fixture tests.
